hooks.name: authoritative-sources-reminder
hooks.description: Mirror of the Claude PreToolUse WebSearch|WebFetch hook in claude/settings.base.json

action.command: echo 'IMPORTANT: Always prefer official documentation and authoritative primary sources. For software/APIs use official docs sites. For cloud use provider docs (docs.aws.amazon.com, cloud.google.com/docs, learn.microsoft.com). For academic topics use peer-reviewed sources, institutional sites, or established encyclopedias. Avoid blogs, Stack Overflow, or tutorial sites as primary sources. Always return the source URL and title.'

hooks.name: ruff-format
hooks.description: Format .py files with ruff after writes/edits (shared script)

hooks.name: md-line-length
hooks.description: Report .md/.txt lines over 80 chars after writes/edits (shared script)
